newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-BALTIJA SHIPYARD TO BE PRIVATISED THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-BALTIJA SHIPYARD TO BE PRIVATISED THIS YEAR.

text.p: The government has decided to drop Baltija shipyard from a list of companies to be sold via open international offers in 1997-1998 and to sell the state's stake in the company this year, the government press office said.
The state runs 32.5 percent in the company and Danish shipbuilder Odense recently bought a more than 40 percent stake in it via share purchases on the bourse.
The government said in a statement late Thursday that the transport ministry has to draw up a privatisation plan for the state's stake in the company by mid-May.
